'''Thades Gorkultok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. By [[3630 BBY]] he became known as the gladiator in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]] under the title "[[District 1327|Breaktown]] Brawler". That year, Thades was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]." During the fight in the Arena, he was assisted by his pets [[King Crush]] and [[Mister Ripper]], but was defeated in the sixth round of the Arena fights.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thades Gorkultok appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the sixth boss of "Eternal Championship".
